evals.name: regular-upgrade
evals.prompt: 我要跑 pacman -Syu 了，先帮我检查下 Arch 官网新闻和论坛有没有需要手动干预的地方。我大概两周前更新的。

script_assertions.name: has-valid-json
script_assertions.description: Output is valid JSON when --json mode is used

script_assertions.name: has-required-fields
script_assertions.description: JSON report contains status, since_date, matches fields

skill_assertions.name: mentions-shadow-issue
skill_assertions.description: LLM reports the shadow/sg issue found in the script output (proves it actually read the report, not just restated the prompt)

skill_assertions.name: mentions-sg-or-newgrp
skill_assertions.description: LLM surfaces the actionable detail (sg command / newgrp) from the shadow topic

evals.name: long-time-no-upgrade
evals.prompt: 我有一台服务器一年半没更新了，之前都是直接 pacman -Syu 的。帮我看看这次升级有没有什么要注意的。

script_assertions.name: lookback-capped
script_assertions.description: Report has lookback_capped=true when user is >1yr behind

skill_assertions.name: recommends-archive
skill_assertions.description: LLM detects lookback_capped and recommends archive.archlinux.org step-wise upgrade (not direct pacman -Syu)

skill_assertions.name: warns-against-direct-syu
skill_assertions.description: LLM warns the user NOT to run pacman -Syu directly on a system this far behind

evals.name: custom-days
evals.prompt: 帮我检查一下最近 90 天 Arch 社区有没有提到 pipewire 升级相关的问题。

script_assertions.name: matches-found
script_assertions.description: Script found at least one match for --days 90

skill_assertions.name: mentions-glibc-crash
skill_assertions.description: LLM reports the glibc/pacman-crash topic the script found (proves it ran the script with the 90-day window rather than just restating 'pipewire' from the prompt)

skill_assertions.name: mentions-pipewire
skill_assertions.description: LLM connects the finding to the user's pipewire concern
